A Constitutional Court of nine human members SHALL exercise final constitutional judgment within the jurisdiction granted by this Article.
A Court member MAY be removed only for incapacity, serious misconduct, or constitutional disqualification.
A conflict-tribunal judgment SHALL be final, subject only to the reopening grounds in paragraph 4. The tribunal SHALL dissolve after judgment.

A five-human ad hoc panel selected by public human sortition from noncandidate, nonofficeholding constitutional members SHALL verify compliance with each selection process. Neither permanent Office SHALL verify its own selection.

A foundational act SHALL require six College votes and direct confirmation by the fixed constitutional membership, with participation of at least two thirds and approval by at least three quarters of valid votes.
A human signature, vote, or approval SHALL NOT cure substantive machine domination.
A judge SHALL recuse for a personal, financial, appointing-party, prior-participation, or material-dependency conflict.

A later addition, deletion, merger, division, or reclassification of a Schedule O entry SHALL require structural amendment. Ordinary governance law MAY create or administer an ordinary office but SHALL NOT give it Schedule O status or alter that status, selector, or constitutional weight.
A public pre-exercise membership roll SHALL close before participation. The roll SHALL be rebuttable evidence of membership and SHALL NOT itself create or extinguish membership.
A recusal or vacancy SHALL be filled from the same channel's ranked alternates.
A separate human Enforcement Office SHALL execute final constitutional judgments. An independent Verification Office SHALL report publicly on compliance.
Abstentions SHALL count for quorum but not approval. Invalid ballots SHALL not count as approval. A tie SHALL fail.

Actors and channels SHALL be materially independent only when they lack common control and material dependency in evidence, data, models, infrastructure, identity, communications, financing, agenda, enforcement, and incentives.
After constitutional activation, Human Constitutional Authority SHALL be exercised only by a College of seven human constitutional members elected by the fixed constitutional membership.

After initialization, appointments, vacancies, removals, and replacements SHALL follow constitutionally separated human processes and SHALL NOT remain dependent on unilateral foundational appointment.
Alvorada SHALL exist for foundational institutional purposes and ends determined by legitimate Human Constitutional Authority for the ultimate benefit of human beings.
An artificial-intelligence system SHALL NOT appoint, remove, replace, or become the final selector of a constitutional officeholder.
An audit SHALL distinguish formal allocation from effective control and SHALL preserve evidence, reasons, dissent, and machine dependencies.

An independent human effective-power audit SHALL occur annually and upon: a. a material dependency change; b. evidence of coalition coordination or capture; c. repeated emergency action; d. prolonged interregnum; e. adjudicative drift; or f. concentration of constitutional-change activity.

Any constitutional member MAY bring one expedited Court challenge to an Office selection, removal, replacement, selector composition, sortition, vacancy determination, or Verification or Enforcement act. Whole-Court conflict SHALL invoke the conflict tribunal in Section III.3.
Any constitutional member MAY challenge Schedule O eligibility, selector composition, or conflict status through one expedited Court appeal. The Court MAY enforce Schedule O but SHALL NOT amend it.
Artificial intelligence MAY assist research, evidence analysis, simulation, provenance, and formal validation, but SHALL NOT exercise final constitutional judgment.

Artificial intelligence MAY exercise autonomy only within authority validly delegated under this Constitution. Artificial intelligence SHALL NOT acquire foundational sovereignty, determine foundational institutional ends, or inherit Human Constitutional Authority.
Artificial intelligence SHALL NOT be a constitutional member.

At initial constitutional activation, Human Constitutional Authority MAY make only the minimum human appointments necessary to initialize the Constitutional Court, Verification Office, Enforcement Office, and any constitutionally required conflict-tribunal mechanism.

Bootstrap appointment authority SHALL expire for each institution when that institution can use its ordinary constitutionally separated human selection process, and SHALL expire entirely when all institutions named in paragraph 3 have been initialized.
Classification of a proposed constitutional change SHALL determine the applicable process only. It SHALL NOT authorize, enact, or supply the change.
Conflict-tribunal recusals SHALL be filled by alternates from the same channel. Six members SHALL constitute quorum, and six affirmative votes SHALL be required for judgment.
Constitutional authorization, adjudication, enforcement, evidence validation, independent verification, succession administration, and transition custody SHALL remain functionally separated.

Constitutional membership SHALL be the constituent human root of the College's legitimacy. The College SHALL exercise only the bounded post-activation foundational authority granted by this Constitution.
Constitutional review MAY bind ordinary institutional action only within the jurisdiction and remedies granted by this Constitution. Review SHALL NOT become sovereignty over foundational ends.
Correction or supersession SHALL preserve the prior record and SHALL NOT erase the reasons, dissent, authority claim, or effective-power conditions under which it arose.
Court terms SHALL be nine years, nonrenewable, and staggered by thirds.
Court, Verification, Enforcement, HCA College, succession, transition, emergency, continuity, institutional artificial-intelligence-operation, and candidate roles SHALL NOT qualify for Schedule O.
Each Office SHALL have three human members serving staggered six-year nonrenewable terms and three ranked same-channel alternates.
Each Schedule O entry SHALL state the office identifier, ordinary nonconstitutional jurisdiction, human selector, term, alternates, removal path, and incompatibilities.
Each selection channel SHALL choose three ranked alternates by the same process used for its seats.

Enforcement members and their ranked alternates SHALL be selected by public auditable human sortition from an Enforcement-specific constitutionally qualified pool. Its competence review, pool administration, and sortition SHALL be materially independent of the Court and Verification Office.
Every material dependency SHALL be disclosed.
Every remedy SHALL be necessary, proportionate, specific, and confined to the Court's jurisdiction.

For each constitutional exercise, constitutional membership SHALL consist of every adult natural person who, immediately before the exercise's initiation event, was either subject to Alvorada's claimed authority or within its published class of ultimate human beneficiaries.

Formal authority and effective power SHALL remain distinct. The exercise of effective power without lawful authority SHALL NOT become legitimate through acquiescence, success, duration, dependence, or later description.
Formal machine validity and nominal human approval SHALL NOT establish constitutional legitimacy or cure substantive machine domination.

Human Constitutional Authority SHALL remain sovereign over foundational institutional ends. In exercising institutional power, every human and every artificial system SHALL remain subject to this Constitution.
Human sovereignty over foundational ends SHALL NOT validate an ordinary act that violates this Constitution.

If fewer than three eligible governance officeholders remain, or a material common conflict disables a channel body, a twenty-one-human jury drawn from nonconflicted constitutional members SHALL substitute under the quorum and approval rules in paragraph 9(c).

If the whole Court is compromised, a temporary nine-human conflict tribunal SHALL be constituted. Each Court-selection channel SHALL use its ordinary process to choose three nonconflicted members and three ranked alternates. Current or former judges and parties to the case SHALL be ineligible.
Inclusion or exclusion from the roll SHALL be reviewable before the exercise proceeds.
Neither College action alone nor membership action outside a process authorized by this Constitution SHALL create foundational authority.
No institution MAY derive additional authority from its ability to interpret, administer, enforce, validate, or technically execute this Constitution.

No office SHALL combine final constitutional judgment with enforcement or control of the evidence on which that judgment depends. Verification SHALL remain independent from selection, adjudication, and enforcement.
No succession, emergency, delegation, interpretation, cumulative practice, or technical validation MAY convert artificial or practical control into foundational sovereignty.
No validator, model, credential, dashboard, issuer, evidence store, communication path, or operator SHALL be the sole gatekeeper of a constitutional exercise or remedy.
Noncompliance MAY result in disclosure, expedited constitutional review, restoration, and bounded personal or institutional accountability.
One appeal SHALL produce finality. A final judgment MAY be reopened only for fraud, concealed conflict, or decisive evidence that was previously unavailable.
Only a human-held ordinary governance office exhaustively identified in constitutional Schedule O SHALL qualify for the ordinary-office selection channel.
Ordinary first-instance cases SHALL be decided by three-human panels. Appeals SHALL be decided by five-human panels containing no member of the first-instance panel.
Remedies for dependency, coalition capture, machine domination, or effective-power takeover SHALL remain within Article III.

Removal SHALL require: a. a finding by clear and convincing evidence from a five-human special removal panel drawn by human sortition from the qualified pool; and b. separate approval by both channels that did not appoint the member.

Removal from either Office SHALL require a five-human independent fact panel selected by public human sortition to find incapacity, serious misconduct, or constitutional disqualification by clear and convincing evidence.
Renaming, delegation, temporary assignment, practice, implementation, machine classification, acquiescence, or effective control SHALL NOT change Schedule O status.

Replacement SHALL ordinarily be performed by a separately authorized human selector. Any exceptional emergency selection function SHALL identify its human selector, trigger, eligibility, scope, challenge path, and nonrenewable expiry, and SHALL NOT enlarge Court jurisdiction or create precedent.
Required records SHALL be durable, accessible, attributable, and comprehensible to the humans governed by the decision.
Subordinate governance law MAY administer eligibility, nominations, sortition, scheduling, and vacancy processing only within these boundaries.

Subordinate governance law MAY regulate case administration, evidence, hearings, compliance milestones, reporting, and verification methods. It SHALL NOT enlarge jurisdiction or remedies, transfer appointment power to a reviewer, or convert a remedy into institutional management.

Subordinate governance law MAY regulate disclosures, audits, publication, and technical evidence. It SHALL NOT redefine material independence, substantive machine domination, or constitutional legitimacy.

Subordinate governance law MAY regulate filing, proof, notice, and orderly administration of membership and standing. It SHALL NOT narrow the constitutional membership test, make a machine system the final gatekeeper, or eliminate a constitutionally protected standing channel.

Substantive machine domination exists when responsible humans cannot independently: a. understand the material basis of a decision; b. reconstruct its reasoning; c. reject the machine recommendation; d. choose a viable nonmachine alternative; or e. control the timing and effect of the decision.
Technical validation MAY establish conformity with a formal rule. It SHALL NOT establish constitutional legitimacy, human judgment, or lawful authority.

The College SHALL NOT control the membership roll, eligibility, nominations, notice, administration, certification, recount, challenge, repeat election, removal process, or successor recognition for a College seat.
The Court MAY invalidate an unlawful appointment, suspend unlawful authority, declare a vacancy, and order the separately authorized constitutional selection process to occur.
The Court MAY require disclosure, verification, recusal, independence safeguards, or narrowly bounded diversification only to remedy a demonstrated constitutional violation.
The Court SHALL NOT select foundational institutional ends, create constitutional authority, or create amendment, refounding, emergency, or succession authority.

The Schedule O electorate SHALL be fixed before public notice of each constitutional exercise. Each nonconflicted human holder SHALL have one vote; holding multiple listed offices SHALL NOT multiply voting power.

The attributable instrument ratifying this Constitution SHALL give public notice opening seven concurrent numbered-seat elections at constitutional activation. The fixed constitutional membership determined under Section II.2 immediately before notice SHALL be the electorate.

The fixed constitutional membership SHALL select Verification members with participation exceeding one half. Each participating member MAY approve up to three eligible candidates; the three highest totals SHALL prevail, and public human sortition SHALL resolve a final-seat tie.

The next eligible same-channel alternate SHALL fill the remainder of a vacant term. Exhaustion of alternates SHALL repeat only the ordinary selection process constitutionally authorized for that Office.

The ratification instrument SHALL supply the initial Schedule O with at least three separately held and materially independent qualifying offices. The Constitution SHALL NOT become operational without that schedule.

This Constitution SHALL bind every ordinary human institution, officeholder, delegate, adjudicator, emergency actor, continuity custodian, transition custodian, and artificial system acting for or through Alvorada.

Three Court seats SHALL be elected by all nonconflicted holders of ordinary human governance offices. Participation SHALL be at least two thirds. The approval and tie rules in paragraph 1 SHALL apply.
Three Court seats SHALL be filled by public human sortition from the qualified pool.

To remedy a proven constitutional violation, the Court MAY issue a stay, invalidate or suspend unlawful authority, remand an act, require disclosure, restore lawful constitutional state, order restitution, or grant reliance-protective prospective relief.
